bio.text: Phillip Chen, a Republican, is a member of the California State Assembly representing District 59 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

Chen graduated from Servite High School and earned a bachelor's degree in communications from California State University, Fullerton, and a master's degree in public administration and a doctorate in education psychology from the University of Southern California.
His career experience includes working as a health deputy to the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors and as a Los Angeles County reserve sheriff's deputy.
